note: Evidence gathering failed on infrastructure, not on the company: search backend refused connections and every free trade-data source was either 403-blocked or JS-gated. Per Rule 5, nothing here is treated as a shipment fact — the company's own name variants, website or catalogue would not count anyway, and none were read. Statuses are 'unknown', NOT 'none_found': I have no basis to assert that no shipments exist, only that no public record was accessible within the tool budget. Revenue and export volume: null (not public / not retrieved) — not estimated. Declared HS 847130 (portable computers) is unverified against any customs line; note the claimed industry 'IT and electronics' sits oddly with the 'Entertainment' name, which is a flag for the next pass but is explicitly NOT grounds for rejection under Rule 3. Recommended follow-up: retry with a working search backend and a paid/authenticated Volza or Eximpedia view, plus MCA master-data lookup for CIN/status to confirm the legal entity exists at all (Rule 3 is the only rejection path, and it was not testable here).
